question:
In the following sentences, explain the antecedent of the pronoun (which thing the pronoun refers to), or state that it is ambiguous.
Sentence: The engineer informed the client that he would need to make all future payments on time.
Options:
(A) The engineer should make payments
(B) The client should make payments
(C) Ambiguous

segments.text: We need to identify antecedent of pronoun "he" in sentence: "The engineer informed the client that he would need to make all future payments on time."
We have two possible referents: engineer (male) or client (could be male).
Grammatically, "he" could refer to either, ambiguous.
Usually "he" refers to the subject of the main clause (engineer) but could be ambiguous.
Options: A: engineer should make payments, B: client should make payments, C: ambiguous.
